section_results.title: Summary of Changes
section_results.new_content:
Converted table-based procedure format to numbered action steps with clear Responsible Party designations
Reorganized content in chronological order of task execution rather than by role
Replaced passive voice and unclear language with active voice imperative mood
Expanded acronyms on first use (SSOPs, SSMPs, OQ, QE)
Replaced "Williams" with "Company" (not present in original, but applied per CREW standards)
Simplified bulleted lists to flow logically from introductory phrases
Corrected capitalization of job titles and organizational terms
Removed hyperlinks per CREW standards (links are not included in markdown output)
Applied consistent formatting to call-outs (NOTE:)
Improved readability by breaking complex steps into single actions
Maintained all compliance requirements and applicability information in simplified format
